nodes.title: Read the package layout
nodes.summary: Section 1: a src-layout package with one function and a unittest suite. No files change. Done when you can name the file that holds greet().

verification.prompt: Say which file defines greet() and why it lives under src/.

nodes.title: Create the greet() function
nodes.summary: Section 2: create src/greetpkg/__init__.py with greet(name). Done when the file exists.
commands:
mkdir -p src/greetpkg tests
cat > src/greetpkg/__init__.py <<'EOF'
def greet(name):
    return 'Hello, ' + name + '!'
EOF

nodes.title: Write pyproject.toml
nodes.summary: Section 3: a build config written but not installed. Done when pyproject.toml exists and names the package.
commands:
cat > pyproject.toml <<'EOF'
[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=61"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "greetpkg"
version = "0.1.0"
EOF

nodes.title: Write the greet() unit test
nodes.summary: Section 4: a unittest module under tests/. Done when the test file exists.

nodes.title: Run the unit tests
nodes.summary: Section 5: run unittest discovery with src on the path. Joins the pyproject and test branches. Done when the suite prints OK.

nodes.title: Add the __main__ entry point (optional branch)
nodes.summary: Section 6: optional. Adds src/greetpkg/__main__.py with main(). Sibling of the release note; it does not block it.
commands:
cat > src/greetpkg/__main__.py <<'EOF'
import sys
from greetpkg import greet


def main(argv=None):
    args = sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv
    print(greet(args[0]))
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())
EOF

nodes.title: Run the package as a module (optional branch)
nodes.summary: Section 7: python3 -m greetpkg Ada prints the greeting. Done when the output contains Hello, Ada.

nodes.title: Record the release note
nodes.summary: Section 8: a manual step outside the workspace. Done when you have written the 0.1.0 note in your own changelog.

verification.prompt: Confirm the 0.1.0 release note is written in your own changelog.
